english: Grandpa's Hatchet
A stone hatchet lashed together by somebody's grandpa, back when things were built to last. It still is.\n\nWears out 75% slower. +25% damage to wood, earth and stone.
The Contractor
A framing hammer with a contractor's name burned into the handle. It's put up more houses than anyone left alive.\n\nRepairs and upgrades 30% faster. +50% XP from repairing and upgrading.
Night Shift

A nail gun that's held more walls together on Blood Moon nights than anyone can count. Someone painted a tally of them down the side.\n\nRepairs twice as much per hit. On Blood Moon nights you take 25% less damage while holding it.
Widowmaker

Loggers call a loose branch that falls without warning a widowmaker. This axe brings the whole tree down instead.\n\n+50% damage to trees. Trees can drop honey like with the Waste Treasures book, and twice as much.
Chopper

A steel axe with a notch in the handle for every zombie it's split in two. Once it gets going, it doesn't want to stop.\n\nKilling a zombie with a power attack makes your axe swing 50% faster and cost no stamina for 5 seconds.
Meat Grinder
A chainsaw with a welded-on second fuel tank and teeth filed to razors. It was made for trees once.\n\nTwice the fuel tank. +25% damage to zombies.
Prospector's Pick

An old prospector's pick, worn smooth where a hundred years of hands held it. It always seems to know where to strike.\n\nOre can drop gold, silver and raw diamonds, at 3 times the Lucky Strike book's chance.
John Henry
Named for the steel-driving man who beat the machine. Every rock it breaks only makes you want to swing again.\n\nEvery block you break gives back 5 stamina. Swings 25% faster.
Big Bertha

A mining crew's pride, with an oversized tank bolted on and the governor ripped out. It chews through rock like it's angry at it.\n\nTwice the fuel tank. Drills 20% faster. +25% damage to stone and metal.
Lucky Spade
A crude stone spade with a four-leaf clover carved into the blade. Folks buried a lot of things when the world ended.\n\nDigging dirt, forest ground and sand sometimes turns up a buried stash.
Trench Raider

A sharpened entrenching shovel from a war long before this one. Soldiers learned it was better for fighting than digging.\n\n+50% damage to zombies. Power attacks have a 25% chance to knock them down.
X Marks the Spot

A treasure hunter's steel shovel with a hand-drawn map etched into the blade. It digs best when there's something to find.\n\nDigs earth 50% faster. Inside a buried treasure circle it digs twice as fast and uses no stamina.
Grease Monkey

A mechanic's wrench, black with fifty years of grease. Whoever owned it could strip a car down to the frame in an afternoon.\n\nSalvaging cars gives 50% more parts, and small engines and car batteries come out in pairs.
Tinkerer
A tinkerer's ratchet with a magnetized head and a set of tiny bits taped to the handle. Nothing electrical is safe from it.\n\n+100% electrical parts and springs from salvaging.
Pit Crew

A race team's impact driver, still wearing its sponsor stickers. It takes the good parts off a car before anyone else gets to them.\n\nSalvages 40% faster. Each car you strip has a 5% chance to drop a crate with a vanilla vehicle mod.
Buried Stash
A rotten little chest somebody buried and never came back for. Open it to see what's inside.
Salvaged Vehicle Mod
A vehicle mod pulled off a wreck in one piece. Open it to see what you got.
Chopper
Your axe swings 50% faster and costs no stamina.
